titles.title: a timed-out CLI child is killed with its process group, so a grandchild it started is gone
a CLI child that exits 0 leaving a background process holding its pipes resolves with exit code 0 and the background process is gone
completeStructured and complete run the CLI in opts.cwd when it is given
completeStructured without opts.cwd runs the CLI in the inherited working directory
a structured call honours its own timeoutMs, so a silent CLI is killed at the caller's limit, not the provider default
a codex run that narrates before answering yields its last agent message to completeStructured and complete
the default chunk limit is 384,000 characters for every provider and follows review.chunkTokens
a review under the limit is one chunk whose calls carry today's messages and schema inside the envelope
a missing or wrong callId is rejected and the call re-issued once under a new callId; no prompt hash repeats
a transient error, a stall or an invalid answer is re-issued once under a new callId, then the stage failure policy applies
a size refusal re-divides exactly the atoms and notes the call carried and never resends the prompt
refusal re-planning reads only the job snapshot, so a changed source between turns cannot change the material
runStage commits a deterministic stage's output; extract claims and probe evidence enter the snapshot once and re-planning reads only them
a re-issued reviewer-session call gets only the remaining time to the job deadline; past the deadline no call is issued and the review fails with today's message
a re-issued reviewer-session call gets only the remaining time to the job deadline; past the deadline no call is issued and the review fails with today's message (runReviewJob)
a review cancelled while a call is in flight ends at once with AbortError, no re-issue, nothing recorded
an obligation whose evidence exceeds the limit is reduced level by level, every gather call fits and provenance is kept
a relation judged by two calls is complete only when both are answered
usage summaries size a chunk and are always kept; proximity summaries are added while they fit, and a last-resort omission is logged
an obligation whose own context does not fit its call is reduced with its evidence, every call fits, provenance names the context, and a context atom too large alone is named
the gather stops, failing the review with nothing recorded, when an obligation's evidence cannot shrink or has not fit after the level limit
a divided review whose result is an array keeps it an array, and its calls per role are read from the job
a gather answer that passes its schema but fails the gather's validate is re-issued once with the reasons, then fails the review
a refused obligation call that carried its raw context reduces that context with its evidence; a context-only obligation still plans reductions
an invalid answer whose correction would not fit the limit is re-issued once as planned, without the correction, and the omission is logged
a stage's countAs is the pipelineCalls role of its chunk calls, re-issues and re-divisions included; the calls keep role 'chunk'
a stage's prompt may declare the atoms it carries, and a stage's redivide replaces a size-refused call with calls within the refused size
a call that did not complete is logged with the failure detail (ISSUE-d3a6b651)
